s1.title: Your idling engine is being carried
s1.description:
At a red light, only one stroke in four actually pushes. What does the work the rest of the time?

#Shorts #howthingswork #cars

s2.title: Why the spark fires early
s2.description:
Burning takes time. The spark starts a kernel that grows into a flame, so it fires before the piston reaches the top.

#Shorts #howthingswork #cars

s3.title: The only stroke that does any work
s3.description:
One stroke in four makes power. The flywheel and the other cylinders carry the rest.

#Shorts #howthingswork #cars

s4.title: Otto built it. Then his patent was revoked.
s4.description:
A French engineer had described the four-stroke cycle in 1862. In 1886 Otto's German patent was revoked.

#Shorts #howthingswork #cars

s5.title: Where the fuel energy actually goes
s5.description:
Only about a fifth of the energy in the fuel moves a typical gasoline car. Most of the rest leaves as heat.
